user.title: Wardrowbe — connection
user.description: Enter the URL of your Wardrowbe install and pick how you want to authenticate.

oidc.title: Wardrowbe — OIDC
oidc.description:
Wardrowbe only accepts sign-ins through its own OIDC client, so the issuer URL and client ID are filled in from the server when it publishes them. If that client has no secret (such as Wardrowbe's mobile client), leave the secret blank and keep PKCE on; otherwise enter the client's secret. Authorize/token URLs are discovered automatically.

In your identity provider, add this redirect URI to the client once: `{redirect_uri}`

data.client_secret: Client secret (leave blank for a public client)
